requirements.quote:
QUIC transport error codes and application error codes are 62-bit
   unsigned integers.
requirements.condition: When representing a QUIC transport error code or application error code.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the error code as a 62-bit unsigned integer.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not represent the error code using a negative value or a value outside the 62-bit unsigned integer range.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation's error-code type, encoder, or decoder can be checked to ensure values are unsigned and restricted to the 62-bit range.
